title: Prophylactic Antibiotics in Measles
brief_summary: Objective It is the objective to test whether the use of prophylactic antibiotics in measles infection will reduce the incidence of post-measles pneumonia and/or admissions to hospital with 50%. The possible impact on other complications of severe measles will also be measured.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* A clinical diagnosis of probable measles in the prodromal phase or within the first seven days of the onset of the rash

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant and nursing women
* Children less than 2 months old
* Children who need urgent referral to the hospital, children with bacterial infections of the lung, or children with another bacterial infection requiring systemic antibiotic treatment.
